scene_prompt: Modern science museum, a child looks through a simple unbranded kaleidoscope held correctly in both hands. Around the child, five soft-edged circular close-up thought bubbles clearly linked to the same kaleidoscope show five DIFFERENT intricate radial patterns made from the SAME tiny colored glass triangles and circles, rotated and recombined in endlessly varied arrangements. Adult companion gently twists the front rotating ring while child watches with wonder. Physical kaleidoscope one long tube, eye to eyepiece, front ring gripped lightly.
